data.situation:
On Wednesday, 12 May, Maya returned at six for an audition in the small theatre. A local group was choosing actors for a summer comedy, and she had promised herself she would try. Jo waited by the door while Maya took a script from a chair and read a scene about two neighbours arguing over a ladder. The organisers became her first audience. One laughed at the wrong moment, which made Maya forget her next line. They let her start again. Afterwards, she found a poster for Saturday’s concert beside the list of names. Jo explained that the musicians would play outside at one. Maya had brought a smart jacket, but everyone else was in casual clothes. She hung it over her arm and walked back to the desk. MUSIC IN THE GARDEN — SATURDAY, 15 MAY, 1 P.M.
This is the first of our free concerts this summer. No ticket is needed. Bring a folding chair if you have one; the audience will sit beside the outdoor stage. Casual clothes are welcome. The musicians will use the theatre if it rains.

readingBlocks.zh: 5月12日星期三，玛雅六点再次来到小剧场参加试演。本地剧团正在为一出夏季喜剧选演员，她答应自己要来试一次。乔在门边等着，玛雅从椅子上拿起剧本，读了一段两个邻居为梯子争吵的戏。组织者成了她的第一批观众，其中一人在意外的地方笑了，玛雅便忘了下一句。他们让她重新开始。试演后，她在名单旁看到了星期六音乐会的海报。乔解释说，乐手会在下午一点到室外演奏。玛雅带了件正式外套，别人却都穿着便装。她把外套搭在手臂上，走回前台。

readingBlocks.en:
MUSIC IN THE GARDEN — SATURDAY, 15 MAY, 1 P.M.
This is the first of our free concerts this summer. No ticket is needed. Bring a folding chair if you have one; the audience will sit beside the outdoor stage. Casual clothes are welcome. The musicians will use the theatre if it rains.
readingBlocks.zh:
花园音乐——5月15日星期六，下午一点
这是我们今年夏天首场免费音乐会，无需门票。有折叠椅的话可以带来，观众将在户外舞台旁就座。穿便装即可。下雨时，乐手会改在小剧场演奏。

glossary.zh: 公开的音乐演出；音乐会
glossary.note: concert为可数名词；free concerts的free仅说明无需入场费，复数与价格修饰共用本单位，整块仍可查。
glossary.example: This is the first of our free concerts this summer.
glossary.exampleZh: 这是我们今年夏天首场免费音乐会。

externalEvidence.definition: a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging

glossary.zh: 实际观看或聆听演出的人群
glossary.note: audience指听众/观众群体；故事中的试演组织者成为第一批观众，告示中的audience为音乐会观众。
glossary.example: The organisers became Maya’s first audience.
glossary.exampleZh: 组织者成了玛雅的第一批观众。

externalEvidence.definition: a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance

glossary.note: a comedy是喜剧作品，故事中夏季演出的剧目有邻居争梯子的滑稽片段。
glossary.example: A local group was choosing actors for a summer comedy.
glossary.exampleZh: 本地剧团在为一出夏季喜剧选演员。

glossary.zh: 为争取演出机会参加的试演或试唱
glossary.note: an audition是选演员/演奏者时的展示，不是已录取后的rehearsal。
glossary.example: Maya returned for an audition in the small theatre.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅再次来到小剧场参加试演。

externalEvidence.definition: a test of the suitability of a performer

glossary.note: casual clothes表示便装，与smart jacket正式外套对照；本例不教偶然或临时工作义。
glossary.example: Everyone else was in casual clothes.

externalEvidence.definition: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
